summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Cemex, S.A.B. de C.V. announcing the signing of a $3 billion syndicated sustainability-linked revolving credit facility. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including refinancing. The facility includes financial covenants (maximum leverage 3.75x, minimum coverage 2.75x) and margin over SOFR based on credit ratings. As a routine debt financing, this does not constitute a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No special situation event is present.
